name: Structured Regulatory Reporting 5
definition: Information needed due to regulatory and statutory requirements.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the type of the information supplied in the regulatory reporting details.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Date related to the specified type of regulatory reporting details.

Country.name: Country
Country.definition: Country related to the specified type of regulatory reporting details.

ReportingCode.name: Reporting Code
ReportingCode.definition: Specifies the nature, purpose, and reason for the transaction to be reported for regulatory and statutory requirements in a coded form.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money to be reported for regulatory and statutory requirements.

Information.name: Information
Information.definition: Additional details that cater for specific domestic regulatory requirements.

ReportingCodeAndInformationRule.definition: Reporting code or information must be present. Both may be present.
